sections.title: Scenario
sections.prompt: Who are the users, what stays with clinicians, and which numbers shape the design?
criteria: States that clinical judgments and attestations stay with licensed clinicians
Converts 3,200 requests at 25 minutes into specialist hours and a target saving
Names the submission deadlines and the payer decision windows from CMS-0057-F
Identifies missing documentation, not payer judgment, as the main denial cause to fix

sections.title: Single View
sections.prompt: Draw the path from an order in either EHR to a payer decision.
criteria: Handles both the FHIR EHR and the HL7 v2 legacy EHR feeding one workflow
Separates rules-based requirement checks from model extraction
Includes a clinician review layer
Shows three submission paths: FHIR PAS, X12 278 and portals

sections.title: Data Sources
sections.prompt: Where does chart data and payer knowledge come from?
criteria: Converts the legacy HL7 v2 feed to FHIR once, through an interface engine or facade
Keeps payer requirement tables as versioned data refreshed on a schedule
Includes inbound faxes as a source with OCR

sections.title: Processing
sections.prompt: How is the chart narrowed to what a payer needs?
criteria: Derives FHIR queries from the payer's criteria rather than sending the whole chart
Excludes 42 CFR Part 2 records without consent
Gives the raw and trimmed token counts

sections.title: Agents
sections.prompt: What does the model do, what does a nurse do, and what does it cost?
criteria: Lists cost levers in order with a monthly saving for each, using the given prices
Requires a verbatim quote and resource id for each answer
Sends uncertain and clinical-judgment answers to a nurse
Has a physician sign appeal drafts

sections.title: Memory
sections.prompt: What does the system learn over time without mixing patients?
criteria: Stores learnings as payer rules or tables, not patient memories
Keeps case state per request with its clock
Avoids retrieving other patients' requests as examples

sections.title: MCP Tool Servers
sections.prompt: Which tools can the model call, and which actions are reserved for the workflow?
criteria: Scopes read tools to one patient, one entity and the request's criteria
Keeps submission out of the model's tools
Separates credentials per legal entity

sections.title: Endpoints
sections.prompt: How does the order-time check meet 1 second, and how does an urgent request meet 4 hours?
criteria: Uses CDS Hooks or an equivalent for the order-time check without a model call
Gives a stage budget under 1 second with a cutoff for slow payer calls
Gives a stage budget for the 4-hour urgent path including nurse review

sections.title: Caching
sections.prompt: What is cached, and what must be refetched?
criteria: Caches requirement tables with a refresh schedule
Refetches chart data before submission when it is stale
Never shares portal sessions across entities

sections.title: Data Stores
sections.prompt: Where does PHI live, for how long, and what does the system cost?
criteria: Sizes the 10-year packet archive from packets a month and bytes per packet
Requires a BAA for every store and service holding PHI, including logs and workflow history
Gives a monthly total with non-model prices labeled as assumed

sections.title: Output
sections.prompt: What do clinicians, specialists and payers receive?
criteria: Stores each packet exactly as sent
Packet contains only what the criteria name, with citations
Gives the specialist a view with the deadline and next action

sections.title: Guardrails
sections.prompt: Which controls protect patients and PHI, and where do they live?
criteria: Enforces minimum necessary in the data fetch layer
Never auto-signs clinical attestations, whatever the confidence
Prevents the agent from changing or cancelling orders
Logs every disclosure to a payer

sections.title: Key Impact
sections.prompt: How do you prove denials fell because of the system?
criteria: Uses a holdout within each payer
Tracks denials for missing documentation and first-pass approval
Acknowledges payer-side changes as a confounder

sections.title: Failure Modes
sections.prompt: What breaks, and how is it caught before a deadline?
criteria: Detects portal layout changes by asserting page elements, not by bot uptime
Gives each request its own deadline timer
Covers clearinghouse and legacy feed outages

sections.title: Build Order
sections.prompt: In what order do you build it in 12 months?
criteria: Starts with the stable FHIR path and highest volume
Runs extraction in shadow with nurse agreement measured
Ends each phase with a number
